subject: POC re-baseline: add conversational PDP use case + revised success criteria
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightcart.com>, Tom Baker <tbaker@brightcart.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & POC plan (BrightCart) — proposed success metrics and timeline

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive conversation earlier. Per our call, I wanted to capture a concise plan for the 6-week POC and call out measurable success criteria so we can avoid ambiguity during the trial. Below is a high-level summary — please flag anything I missed.

Scope (initial):
- Primary: reranking of search results for category pages (desktop + mobile).
- Traffic sample: 10K queries/day (pilot index), expanding to a 7-day window for evaluation.
- Integration: server-side inference behind BrightCart API (no client changes).

Success criteria (baseline):
- Relevance uplift: +8% CTR on top-3 organic results vs baseline A/B test
- Latency: inference p95 < 150ms (service-side)
- Reliability: 99.5% availability for inference endpoints
- Cost: unit inference cost <= $0.40 per 1k tokens (target for hosted evaluation)

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (next week): kickoff, credentials & dataset sampling
- Week 1–2: model onboarding + integration adapter
- Week 3: run live sample, collect metrics
- Week 4: evaluation and refinements
- Week 5: final analysis, decision meeting

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (draft), evaluation-metrics.xlsx (metric templates).

Next steps for BrightCart: share sample logs (anonymized) and a primary POC owner.

Owners at Redwood: Lauren (technical integration), Monica (project lead). I will own the commercial checklist and run the weekly syncs.

If that looks right, I’ll upload the SOW to DocuSign and propose kickoff times for next Tuesday/Wednesday.

Thanks —
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightcart.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@brightcart.com>, Allison Ng <allison.ng@brightcart.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan (BrightCart) — proposed success metrics and timeline

Thanks Karthik — this is a great summary. Two quick asks from our side after internal review: 

1) Add a second use case: conversational Product Detail Page (PDP) Q&A (text only for this POC). Customers should be able to ask 5–6 common product questions and get concise answers. We want to measure answer accuracy and helpfulness separately from reranking.

2) Can you add quality metrics for the PDP Q&A? Specifically: answer F1 vs labeled set (we can supply 300 labeled Q/A pairs), and human helpfulness score (1–5) sampled from 200 sessions.

Procurement note (Allison): we’ll need a revised SOW that calls out the additional use case and adjusted timeline if it pushes final delivery beyond the original 6 weeks.

Tom and I are available for a 30-min sync tomorrow if you want to walk through how this affects integration effort.

—Elena

Elena Morales
Head of Product, BrightCart
elena@brightcart.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightcart.com>, Tom Baker <tbaker@brightcart.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan (BrightCart) — proposed success metrics and timeline

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Quick notes after a fast sync internally:

- The PDP Q&A add is feasible, but it does shift effort: we’ll need labeling ingestion, a small QA harness, and a user-sampling hook for the helpfulness survey.

Proposed re-baselined success criteria (adds are bolded):
- Reranking (as above): +8% CTR top-3, p95 latency < 150ms
- PDP Q&A (new): F1 >= 0.72 on the 300-label holdout AND mean helpfulness >= 4.0 (sample N=200)
- Reliability: 99.5% combined (both endpoints)
- Cost: revised target <= $0.55 per 1k tokens (added compute for Q&A)

Revised timeline option A (minimal extension):
- Week 0–1: kickoff + sample delivery + label ingestion
- Week 2–3: integration + model tuning for rerank + Q&A fine-tune + survey hook
- Week 4: live sample run for both flows
- Week 5: metric collection and soft decision
- Week 6: final analysis and decision meeting

This makes the POC 7 weeks total. If BrightCart prefers to keep a strict 6-week window we can scope the Q&A as a lightweight natural-language fallback (no fine-tune, eval only) and measure helpfulness post-POC.

I’ll prepare a re-baselined SOW and updated evaluation spreadsheet; tagging Monica to pull budget/hosting guidance. Lauren — can you confirm the technical lift estimate (hours + key integration risks) so we can include it in the SOW?

Karthik
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@brightcart.com>, Tom Baker <tbaker@brightcart.com>, Allison Ng <allison.ng@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan (BrightCart) — proposed success metrics and timeline

Hi all — Lauren here (integration lead). Quick technical estimate and risks for the SOW: 

Estimate (Redwood effort):
- Integration adapter + dataset hooks: 40 engineer hours
- Q&A labeling ingestion + evaluation harness: 24 engineer hours + 8 hours for survey instrumentation
- Monitoring and dashboarding for both flows: 12 engineer hours
- Total: approx 84 engineer hours across team (spread over Weeks 1–4)

Key risks and mitigations:
- Data formatting mismatches: we’ll provide a sample ingestion schema and a validator script; BrightCart needs to provide a week-long sample by kickoff.
- Latency at scale: if observed p95 exceeds threshold we’ll propose: enable batching window tuning OR deploy a lighter quantized model for inference.
- Human labeling throughput: if BrightCart cannot provide labels quickly, Redwood can assist with labeling at cost (see SOW appendix).

Monica — can you confirm whether Dedicated capacity is required for the Q&A experiment (expected to increase throughput) or whether Hosted evaluation is acceptable for BrightCart’s data sensitivity?

I’ll include these numbers in the updated SOW and send a draft to Allison for procurement review.

Thanks —
Lauren
From: Allison Ng <allison.ng@brightcart.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@brightcart.com>, Tom Baker <tbaker@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T17:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan (BrightCart) — proposed success metrics and timeline

Thanks for the update. Procurement is OK with a 1-week extension to include PDP Q&A as a scoped deliverable. Please: 

1) Send an updated SOW that calls out the 7-week schedule and the labelling commitment (BrightCart to deliver 300 labeled Q/A pairs by Week 1).
2) Include explicit billing lines for optional labeling support and any Dedicated capacity (if required).
3) Add a short clause about data handling: logs must be encrypted in transit and we need a retention window of 90 days for trial logs.

We’ll sign once SOW is received and the DocuSign link is up.

Best —
Allison Ng
Senior Procurement Manager, BrightCart
